definitions.explanation: A mathematical value; a count or amount.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数|すう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: To teach children the concept of number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数|すう}{人|にん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
⟦{偶数|ぐうすう}→偶数：00077_guusuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{奇数|きすう}→奇数：09634_kisuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: Divide into even and odd numbers.

notes:
{数|すう} is used both independently and as a component in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{数|すう}{人|にん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧ (several people)
- {数|すう}⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ (tens, dozens)
- {数|すう}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundreds)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧ (number of people)
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧ (numeral, digit)
- ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧ (mathematics)
- ⟦{偶数|ぐうすう}→偶数：00077_guusuu⟧ (even number)
- ⟦{奇数|きすう}→奇数：09634_kisuu⟧ (odd number)
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (large number, majority)
- ⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧ (small number, minority)

PRONUNCIATION:
{数|すう} is the on'yomi reading used in compounds. The kun'yomi is ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧, the usual standalone word for "the number of things": ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧, ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧.
